title: The derived square isomorphism commutes with the shift isomorphisms of the inverse images
statement:
Let $\square=(f,f',g,g',\alpha)$ be a cartesian square of schemes [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], with $f:X	o Y$, $g:Y'	o Y$, $f':X'	o Y'$, $g':X'	o X$, and let $	heta^D_\square:f'^{-1}g^{-1}\xrightarrow{\sim}g'^{-1}f^{-1}$ be the derived square isomorphism of functors $\Dplus(Y_{\Et})	o\Dplus(X'_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-square-iso]. Give each inverse image $u^{-1}$ on bounded below derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image] its shift-commutation isomorphism $\iota^u_M:u^{-1}(M[1])\xrightarrow{\sim}(u^{-1}M)[1]$, the identity of the termwise shifted complex $u^{-1}(M^ ullet[1])=(u^{-1}M^ ullet)[1]$ on a representing complex ($(M[1])^r=M^{r+1}$, $d_{M[1]}=-d_M$), and give the composites $f'^{-1}g^{-1}$ and $g'^{-1}f^{-1}$ the composite isomorphisms $\varphi_M=\iota^{f'}_{g^{-1}M}\circ f'^{-1}(\iota^g_M)$ and $\psi_M=\iota^{g'}_{f^{-1}M}\circ g'^{-1}(\iota^f_M)$ [lem-weil-pbc-triangulated-functor-composite]. Then for every $M\in\Dplus(Y_{\Et})$
$$
 \psi_M\circ	heta^D_{\square,M[1]}=	heta^D_{\square,M}[1]\circ\varphi_M:\ f'^{-1}g^{-1}(M[1])\longrightarrow(g'^{-1}f^{-1}M)[1],
$$
and hence the same holds for the iterated isomorphisms $\varphi^{(n)},\psi^{(n)}$ and the shifts $[n]$, $n\in\mathbf Z$.

proof.text: Work directly on the bounded below derived categories. For an isomorphism e:F ≅ G of exact functors, the factorization formula mapDerivedCategoryPlusNatIso_hom_app_factorsh identifies Qh whiskered with the induced comparison as beta_F.hom followed by Qh applied to mapHomotopyCategoryPlus(e.hom), followed by beta_G.inv. Each factor commutes with every integer shift: the beta factors by mapDerivedCategoryPlusFactorsh shift compatibility, and the middle term by the termwise natural-transformation compatibility and whiskering. The functor Qh is essentially surjective, so NatTrans.CommShift.of_whiskerLeft detects shift compatibility on its image and proves it for the induced derived natural isomorphism.

proof.text: For exact F and G, let e be the composite identification from Qh followed by F_D+ followed by G_D+ to (F composed with G)_H+ followed by Qh: reassociate, whisker the factorization of F by G_D+, reassociate, whisker the factorization of G by F_H+, reassociate, and apply Qh to the homotopy composition comparison. Each factor commutes with all shifts, including the termwise composition comparison. The existing identity mapDerivedCategoryPlusFactorsh_comp says that Qh whiskered with the derived composition comparison, followed by e, is beta_(F composed with G). Thus the whiskered derived composition comparison is beta_(F composed with G).hom followed by e.inv and commutes with all shifts. Detect compatibility through the essentially surjective Qh as in Step 1.
